desc: Sort arrays A and B, and compute prefix sums for both.
For each query (X_k, Y_k), extract the subarrays A[0:X_k] and B[0:Y_k] (which are already sorted).
Use a two-pointer approach to compute sum_{i=0}^{X_k-1} sum_{j=0}^{Y_k-1} |A_i - B_j| in O(X_k + Y_k) time.
Print the result for each query.
